name: Health Potion
desc: A red tonic brewed in the Holy City. Restores 30 health.

name: Greater Health Potion
desc: A deep crimson draught for long journeys. Restores 60 health.

name: Longsword
desc: Dave's steel blade from the Holy City guard. Balanced and reliable.

name: Bandit Scimitar
desc: A curved desert blade taken from a bandit camp. Wide, quick cuts.

name: Sunsteel Blade
desc: An ancient sword that glows like noon light. Long reach and a heavy edge.

name: Worn Tabard
desc: The ivory tabard of the Holy City, frayed by the siege.

name: Wanderer Tunic
desc: Layered desert cloth that keeps out sand and blades alike.

name: Iron Tunic
desc: Riveted iron plates from a bandit stockpile. Heavy but sturdy.

name: Paladin Mail
desc: Silver mail left at the memorial by a fallen order. It still shines.

name: Gold Coins
desc: Coins of many kingdoms, worn smooth by desert trade.

name: Desert Rose
desc: A crystal bloom formed in the sand. Beautiful, but of no use on the road.

name: Golden Scarab
desc: A royal charm of beaten gold, sealed in an old cistern.

name: Ancient Coin
desc: A coin stamped with a forgotten pharaoh's face.

name: Pharaoh's Ankh
desc: The Undead Pharaoh's ankh. It is not the Grail, but it proves the way east is open.
